digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Here's your holiday end-of-day snapshot. The dashboard was last updated November 16, so the open list may not reflect more recent progress.

items.label: Confirm Wave 2 recovery and coverage
items.detail: Tier 2 went live Tuesday; six queues are scheduled for December 1-2. Jenn still flags deployment risk from staffing and approximately 164 active users missing language skills. Confirm coverage and the audit follow-up with Thiago. Voicemail routing was subsequently reported restored.

items.label: Confirm MHE decisions and pilot readiness with Mar
items.detail: Confirm Angel's answers on mandatory evaluations and the path to IT, along with approvals, provider onboarding and the revised pilot date.

items.label: Check the overdue Rippling task
items.detail: The November 25 notice still lists Dominican Republic harassment prevention training as overdue. Check its current status in Rippling.

items.label: Confirm Universal Intake project leadership
items.detail: Jean told Anu that Isabella was recently assigned as BA and discussions had not yet started; IT still needs requirements to create stories. Confirm the project lead and next steps.

items.label: Follow up on Re-Open Cases closure
items.detail: Confirm the timing of the closure follow-up: a participant requested a change because of a public holiday. The agenda calls for owners, deadlines and a target closure date.

items.label: Follow up on the Power BI assignment
items.detail: The November 5 reporting request was unassigned and blocking the project for selling services to leads with ongoing cases. Check the request sent to Matthew; Leandro and Kevin were waiting for an assignment.

items.label: Follow up on EKM dependencies and timing
items.detail: Pilot stories passed grooming, but Legal capacity, approval governance, Salesforce migration and delivery dates remained open. Confirm ownership and timing ahead of the pilot.

items.label: Amazon Connect daily standup and Jean/Sara 1:1
items.detail: Both meetings were marked canceled on today's calendar.

items.label: Friday holiday and executive slide update
items.detail: The calendar marks the US holiday and an out-of-office entry. Executive Project Status Slide Update is at 3:00 PM AST; the EPMO management meeting, IT sync and Amazon Connect standup are marked canceled.
